name: tragedy_loop
description: 惨剧轮回资料整理、教学文档与电子化原型项目。

scripts.slides:diagrams: mmdc -i products/slides/assets/game-flow.mmd -o products/slides/assets/game-flow.png -b transparent && mmdc -i products/slides/assets/round-flow.mmd -o products/slides/assets/round-flow.png -b transparent
scripts.slides:build: npm run slides:generate && npm run slides:diagrams && mkdir -p products/public/slides/assets && cp products/slides/assets/*.png products/public/slides/assets/ && marp products/slides/beginner-teaching.marp.md --html --allow-local-files -o products/public/slides/beginner-teaching.html
